text:
devon: Heads-up — noticed a spike of GPU nodes stuck in PROVISIONING after last night's keystore rotation + new egress tiering. Pods boot but decrypt fails, warm pools not filling. 😕
aj: saw the same, +1. Audit logs show a TON of `kms:Decrypt` denied from the node role around 00:12 UTC.
maria: is this the ephemeral keystore rollout we pushed? I did a gradual change but left the privatelink policy tightened.
kevin: yep we flipped `ephemeral-keystore-v2` and tightened VPC egress rules to force traffic through the new privatelink endpoints to limit NAT costs. Suspect endpoint SG didn't include the keystore subnet?
elaine: logs snippet from node (condensed):
```
2026-03-19T00:12:05Z ERR keystore: decrypt failed code=AccessDenied principal=arn:aws:iam::123:role/gpu-node-role key=ephemeral-keystore-v2
2026-03-19T00:12:06Z WARN warmup: cannot fetch kv-cache, retrying
```

aj: that matches — the KMS key policy expects `sts:AssumeRole` from the provisioning service principal, but nodes are hitting the privatelink proxy which is returning 403 because its ENI IPs weren't whitelisted in the key policy.
devon: could be. Also saw broker-level 502s from the privatelink when many nodes attempted decrypt concurrently — looks like connection limits + stale SGs.
sre-oncall: immediate mitigation options?
maria: short term: roll back keystore v2 (we can re-enable v1) or widen KMS key policy to include the privatelink IAM principal and add the privatelink ENI CIDR to the key's condition. Either would restore warmup.
kevin: rollback is quickest but increases attack surface we were trying to close. Widening policy will take a few mins for terraform apply, and we need TO run it in prod region eu-west-1 too. Cost-wise, if we fallback to NAT to bypass privatelink we'll eat ~ $0.045/hr per node + data egress delta — could be thousands for a day during surge.
elaine: we should avoid NAT if possible. Suggest staged policy patch: add the privatelink service principal + a short-lived condition on `aws:SourceIp` to the key policy, then monitor.
deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-19T00:05:00Z — terraform apply plan: `modules/keystore/main.tf` (apply started by maria).
aj: also worth noting the autoscaler backoff: nodes keep retrying decrypt -> fail -> drain -> reprovision. That churn is what's killing warm pools and increasing spare capacity cost.
devon: exact. We're paying provisioning churn + cold-start latency for real traffic. Current cost hit estimate for the last hour: ~ $1.2k (extra spot/ondemand churn and delayed warmup).
maria: I'm going to open a fast patch: add `arn:aws:iam::123:role/privatelink-proxy` to the KMS key policy and include the privatelink ENI CIDR block in the `Condition` for 10 minutes, then rotate to a safer allowlist. Will post tf diff.
kevin: make sure to update the firewall rule in the privatelink SG too — I think it was set to 10.100.0.0/16 but our new keystore ENIs are 10.110.x.x.
sre-oncall: after policy change we should kick a small canary: 3 nodes -> ensure decrypt success -> check warm pool fill rate and agent logs. If green, scale gradually.
devon: agreed. Also add a temporary alert to pager: high `keystore.decrypt.failures` > 5/min for 5m.
aj: to prevent recurrence post-fix: propose we add an integration test in staging that provisions nodes while we toggle keystore variants and privatelink SG permutations. Also add an automated check that KMS key policies include privatelink principals when egress-tiering is enabled.
elaine: and add a runbook note: when toggling ephemeral keystores, validate KMS key policy + ENI CIDRs + privatelink SGs first. Small checklist in the PR template.
maria: TF plan posted: `+ aws_kms_key_policy.ephemeral_keystore` (added privatelink role, CIDR 10.110.0.0/24 with `For 10m`). Applying in 60s.
infra-bot: terraform apply complete: 3 resources updated, 0 created, 0 destroyed.
deploy-bot: canary scale event triggered: provisioning 3 gpu-nodes-canary.
aj: canary logs show `kms:Decrypt` success and warmup KV fetch completed. Warm pool fill improved from 0% -> 80% in 6m.
kevin: cost note: keep an eye on NAT usage metric `billing.egress_nat_bytes`. If we see spike fallback to NAT then stop rollout and revert.
sre-oncall: thanks team — next steps: maria will monitor for 30m then promote rollout. aj to add tests and PR template update. devon to file a short postmortem with cost delta + root cause.
devon: filing postmortem now, will include timeline and the keystore policy diff. tl;dr: missing privatelink principal + ENI CIDR in KMS policy caused decrypt failures which cascaded into provisioning churn and warmpool starvation.
maria: sorry about the rollout surprise — will follow new checklist. :lock:
kevin: lessons learned logged in infra playbook.
elaine: closing loop: once fully rolled out we should schedule a controlled teardown to ensure key rotation + privatelink policies are in sync, otherwise we keep getting surprises when we harden egress.
devon: thanks all. I'll post the postmortem link here when ready.
(threads often short; follow-ups as needed)
